```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py'
      - 'src/**'
      - '.github/workflows/claude-review.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Claude Code
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://anthropic.github.io/claude-code/get-cli.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.claude/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          # Get the diff of the current PR
          git diff origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD > pr.diff
          
          # Run Claude Code to review the changes
          claude \
            --print \
            --prompt "Please review the following pull request changes for the NVIDIA-NeMo/Evaluator repository.
            
            Focus on:
            1. Correctness of the slurm executor argument wiring
            2. Proper handling of CLI args and environment variable fallbacks
            3. Removal of SSH-related parameters
            4. Code style and best practices
            5. Potential edge cases or errors
            
            Here is the diff:
            $(cat pr.diff)
            
            Provide a concise review with specific suggestions if improvements are needed." \
            --output-format json | jq -r '.content[0].text' > claude-review.txt
          
          # Post the review as a comment
          if [ -s claude-review.txt ]; then
            gh pr comment ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --body-file claude-review.txt
          fi
```
